newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian financial report still unfinished.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian financial report still unfinished.

text.p: The Wallis inquiry into the Australian financial system has not yet reported to Treasurer Peter Costello, contrary to a report in The Australian Financial Review newspaper, a spokeswoman said on Friday.
The spokeswoman reaffirmed that the inquiry would hand its report to Costello by the end of March and that Costello would then determine when to release it publicly.
The inquiry is the first major review of Australian financial regulation since the early 1980s.
Its wide-ranging report is expected to include a recommendation to end the current "six-pillars" policy which prevents mergers between the four big Australian banks and two largest life offices.
Analysts also expect it to recommend that mergers be determined by the anti-monopoly authority rather by the government ad hoc.
